claim: The D18/PY-IT/eC9 primary anchor establishes scanned J-V device performance and mechanism evidence, but the inspected primary article does not establish stabilized maximum-power output; therefore it cannot by itself satisfy the repository useful-work gate requiring stabilized Pmax.

source.title: Suppressing electron-phonon coupling and energy loss in organic solar cells by modulating donor-acceptor penetrated-interface

observations.reported_jsc_ff_statement: no sacrifice in JSC and FF

validity_domain: Evidence classification of the inspected primary article/main-text Methods and data-availability statement only; absence here does not prove supplementary, unpublished, or later stabilized measurements do not exist.
falsifier: A source-verifiable target-chemistry stabilized-Pmax/MPPT measurement with provenance and sufficient device/lot hierarchy would supersede or narrow this boundary.
decision: Do not count anchor scanned PCE as stabilized useful-work evidence. Require prospective stabilized Pmax on B0/B1/B2 together with field-generation and transport/contact controls.
